precise_regression: Canonical connection with an enclosing caller-owned transaction: file1 succeeds, file2 fails before end-of-window flush. Original public write_file_data has already mirrored file1; new path can leave its base without files/literal FTS. Caller can catch Err and commit because public SnapshotWriteTxn borrows Connection and owns no transaction. Schema and rowid checks do not fix this.

current_production_calls.fact: Only production call to write_file_data; propagates ? before remaining snapshot content.
Three wrappers instantiate seam and return contents Result directly to owning adapters.
Temp-staging transaction calls write_fn? before commit, on Err drops transaction/connection and removes temp file.
build_rebuild_staging? stops before swap on any build error.

DirectWriter owns transaction and write_fn? precedes commit; error returns before adapter success. journal OFF means physical rollback durability is not claimed; containing rebuild protocol still prevents failed temp publication.

options.name: A_minimal_new_rebuild_entry
options.changes: Restore public write_file_data original exact loop. Place batching under a new explicitly rebuild-only method. Change only shared contents callsite111, covering all three existing owning adapters; retain their existing ?/abort publication protocol.
options.new_contract: On any error, entire rebuild owner must abandon transaction/staging and never publish. This is a new API with its own caller obligation; an &Connection signature alone does not enforce ownership.
options.minimum_validation: Old public API catch-error-then-commit must retain original partial rows+FTS; new method all differential/canonical guard/nearMAX controls plus actual adapter fast activation and late base error; add real flush error with owner no-publish assertion, retain all failures. At least relevant cc-index compile/regression tests due one new callsite.
options.limitations: No silent weakening of old API documentation; no all-batch savepoint added to old method. If own atomic rollback is required even for callers violating new API obligation, a distinct ownership/callback/savepoint design is needed and not part of the current minimal change.
